subject: Planned demo on hold — region outage + staffing redistribution
messages:

Subject: Redwood demo — Wed Feb 17 10:00 PT (agenda attached)

Hi Amal,

Thanks again for coordinating time with the team — confirming our scheduled demo:
- When: Wed, Feb 17 at 10:00 AM PT
- Who: Amal + Ravi (infra), Starnet procurement (observe), Grace (AE), Dev (SE)

Attached is a concise agenda (10–30 min walkthrough + 30 min deep dive + Q&A) and a short pre-demo checklist. If you need a different time or want us to focus on VPC/networking first, say the word.

Action items before demo:
- Amal/Ravi: list of any compliance questions to surface ahead of time
- Procurement: confirm attendees if they want pricing discussion

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf

—
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Amal Qureshi <amal@starnet.io>

Cc: Ravi Iyer <ravi.iyer@starnet.io>, Starnet Procurement <procurement@starnet.io>
Date: 2027-02-11T09:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — Wed Feb 17 10:00 PT (agenda attached)

Grace —

Thanks for the confirmation and the agenda. Quick update from our side: our infra team is still dealing with an escalated outage in us-west-2 that started late last night. Ravi and two of our engineers are tied up with the incident response and may not be available that week. Also, our head of procurement is out on travel and will not be back until the 23rd.

Given the risk that key folks will be pulled into the outage or procurement conversations, can we put the demo on hold for now? We still want to move forward but need to ensure the right people can attend.

Apologies for the short notice — we know this is late in the week. We can propose new windows once the outage stabilizes and procurement returns.

Cheers,
Amal
Infrastructure Lead — Starnet Communications
amal@starnet.io

Thanks for flagging this, Amal — sorry to hear about the outage. A couple of quick options from the SE side: 

1) If you still want a short technical sync while the infra team is on call, I can do a 20–30 minute focused session on our network/VPC best practices and fallbacks (no procurement/pricing). I am available Thurs Feb 18 morning PT.

2) If the priority is to wait until procurement is back and infra is stable, we can hold the live demo and reconvene the week of Feb 28.

3) Alternatively, I can record a short walkthrough of the demo deck + a 10-minute deep-dive clip on KV cache and routing and share it for asynchronous review — we can follow up with a short live Q&A when your team is available.

We also have backup SE coverage: Ava can stand in for me if I get pulled into travel support coverage next week. Ava — are you able to cover a live session on Feb 17 if needed?

Attachment: SE-coverage-grid.xlsx (shows availability for the next 3 weeks).

—
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com

Amal / Grace —

From a procurement perspective, since our standard PO review requires the procurement lead to be involved for any contract/PO discussions, I support putting the demo session that includes pricing on hold until their return (post-23rd). If the goal is purely technical validation, we should still plan for a follow-up with procurement so there are no surprises.

If holding the live session is the preferred path, we can tentatively target the week of Feb 28 for a joint technical + procurement session. I can open a DocuSign pre-approval link for their review in the meantime to speed things up once procurement is back: https://docusign.com/abcdef-PO-4832

If you want a short recorded demo now (as Dev suggested), that would keep momentum without pulling procurement. Happy to coordinate the pricing discussion when procurement is back.

—
Markus Klein
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Redwood demo — Wed Feb 17 10:00 PT (agenda attached)

Appreciate the quick updates, everyone.

Plan going forward: 
- Hold the live demo that includes pricing until procurement returns (post-Feb 23).
- Dev / Ava: please prepare a 12–15 minute recorded technical walkthrough focused on the VPC, fallback, and routing behavior. Dev, if you can record by Feb 16, we will share it with Ravi and the on-call team for asynchronous review.
- Markus: thanks — if you can open the DocuSign pre-approval that will help compress timelines when procurement returns.
- Amal / Ravi: once the outage is stable and procurement confirms availability, Grace will propose 2 windows the week of Feb 28 (one morning PT and one late-afternoon PT).

I’ll update the calendar invite to an internal "On Hold" status and attach the recording when ready. If anything changes and your team becomes available earlier, please let us know — we can pivot to a short technical-only slot.

Thanks,
Grace

—
